name: Differential path integral estimator with MIS and NEE
definition: Computes the gradient of the rendered image with respect to parameters θ by integrating differential measurement contributions over path space, using MIS to combine BRDF and emitter sampling, and NEE to connect paths to emitters.
summary: This estimator computes image gradients by combining multiple importance sampling with next event estimation to locate differential vertices at any path vertex, reducing noise in complex scenes.
